mentions.name: Deelmobiliteit Delft
mentions.description: This website logs the availability of every shared scooter and bike inside the Delft city boundary, based on the open GBFS data feed, enabling historical analysis such as how often operators exceed their permitted vehicle caps and how long vehicles sit unused.
mentions.problem: Shared mobility operators may exceed city vehicle caps and leave vehicles unused, and without anyone keeping a record the public debate runs on anecdotes rather than data.
mentions.audience: Public debate on shared mobility and local government accountability
mentions.source_excerpt: The site, https://deelmobiliteitdelft.nl, logs the availability of every shared vehicle inside the city boundary. This allows me to do interesting analysis. For example, one operator has been above its vehicle limit 80% of the time.
